title: Three Shifts and One Short Switch
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：software　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 software 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the operator ① wrote the software that no trainee in the station would have recorded, and he said the writing was the whole of the shift. The ② software, meaning the programme itself and not the switch, ran three shifts and stayed unrecorded in the book; software, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of software in that station had the same short switch beside it, and the ④ software at the far screen, meaning the cable they kept for the children to check and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Software, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the operator said the recording is the part that fills three shifts.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the software was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the programme. The ⑥ software, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; software, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both programme and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ software had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short switch. The ⑧ software of the whole thing, the operator wrote in June, was one station and three shifts of recording; software, he said, is either the cable at the far screen or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ software I remember is the software recorded in the log, which closed in 1986 and is still recorded as the quietest in the station. ⑩ Software, my mother said in 1988, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all software, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like programme. She said the skill was the honest half.
